name: Panorama Nha Trang StarBeach
detail: The hotel has a youthful, modern design that looks newly finished. The rooms are clean, spacious, and fully equipped with amenities. The staff is enthusiastic and cheerful, creating a close and pleasant atmosphere for guests.

name: Tuana Hotels Cam Ranh Resort
detail: I used the connecting room and found some sand and dust on the floor. If you're going to have breakfast, make sure to purchase the package that includes it. If you want to eat separately, it costs 350,000 VND per person (for ages 6 and older). The breakfast cost is more expensive than the accommodation cost. There was a staff member who spoke Korean. The beach is right in front, and the swimming pool was beautiful despite being in direct sunlight. It's good value for money. They do not provide airport pickup or drop-off services.

name: Holi Panorama Condotel
detail: Overall Review: The location is very good, the staff are friendly, and the value for money is great. Advantages: 1. The location is excellent as it is right in front of the beach. 2. The lobby and rooms are clean. 3. The swimming pool on the 6th floor is decent. 4. There is a hotel KakaoTalk QR code in the room for contact, and they respond very kindly. 5. It is nice to use the Blue Sky on the 40th floor. Disadvantages: 1. There is a spa on the 6th floor, but you need to pay a separate fee (40,000-50,000 VND per hour) to use it. 2. There are not many elevators, so there can be some waiting time.

name: Prime New
detail: The hotel is very clean, conveniently located near the center and the beach, making it easy to move around with small children. Especially, the receptionist was very helpful and caring. I will come back to support the hotel when I have the chance to go to Nha Trang. The prices are affordable and the sea view is very nice.

name: Vinpearl Beachfront Nha Trang
detail: I came with my mother-in-law and 4 adults, and we are very satisfied. The 2-room, 2-bathroom setup was great. The location right in front of the beach offered excellent accessibility, and we were very pleased with the size and cleanliness of the rooms. The breakfast and the pool were also excellent, and thanks to the friendly attitude of the staff and the housekeeping service, we were able to stay comfortably. The additional facilities were also well-equipped, making it an overall great value accommodation.
area: Loc Tho,Nha Trang - View on map

name: Havana Nha Trang Hotel
detail: I was a bit unsure after reading reviews of the Havana Hotel, but the shower drained well and the air conditioning was great. The only downside was the food; the breakfast buffet really didn't have much to eat. It was food that didn't suit Korean tastes, I guess. Other than that, there was nothing to complain about. I stayed in a club suite on the 27th floor, but the queen-sized bed was a bit uncomfortable for me and my son. However, the living room sofa was excellent when we used it. They also brought extra blankets, and the service from the staff was top-notch. The hotel is old and has a bit of a musty smell, but it seems well-maintained. I highly recommend it for the price. There are Hyatt and Intercontinental hotels next door, but their room sizes were smaller. I chose this place because it offered larger rooms for the price, and I am satisfied. The location is good too; there are night markets and shopping malls just a short walk away. Overall, I'm happy considering the price. It was great to be able to access the beach via the underground passage, but the beach beds were too small and filled up by 6 AM. Other than that, I was satisfied. I walked on the underground passage carpet, and it was clean.
area: Loc Tho,Nha Trang - View on map

name: Florida Hotel
detail: The cost-performance ratio is high, breakfast is quite good, the rooftop pool is relatively small with basically no space for loungers, but the view is very beautiful. The location is also good, with a pharmacy and some small restaurants nearby, and it's quite close to the bank. You must try the sugarcane juice across the street, it's only 12K and very tasty! The front desk staff are also very nice, but the check-in time is a bit late; is it really that tight for rooms in such a large hotel?

name: Novotel Nha Trang Hotel
detail: I was able to relax both physically and mentally during my trip with my daughter. Our room had an ocean view, and from the bed, there were a few steps down to a sofa corner. From there, we went out to a balcony with deck chairs. While eating a banh mi and looking at the sea from the deck chair, a big rainbow appeared... it really became a wonderful memory. I would love to stay again!!

name: Diamond Bay Hotel
detail: This place is very convenient for walking and moving around, with clean room service and hot water always available. The surrounding area is also easy for shopping, and the staff is friendly and attentive, creating a comfortable atmosphere throughout the stay. The amenities are diverse, meeting all needs, and it's very worthwhile for the money spent.

name: Starcity Bayfront Nha Trang Hotel
detail: Nha Trang City Budget Accommodation Recommendation | Star City Beachfront Star Suite Room Review 📍 Great Location! Enjoy both city infrastructure and beach Located right next to Vinpearl Beachfront, it has good infrastructure including restaurants, cafes, and massage services, and since the beach is just across the street, the location was really convenient. 🛏️ The Star Suite Room was perfect for our family With a separate living room and bedroom and two bathrooms, it was just right for our family with my snoring husband, and the room was quite spacious for the price. 🌹 Uplifting Welcome Service Upon entering the room, we were greeted by a welcome fruit basket and rose petal decorations in the bedroom and bathroom, making us feel like we were on our honeymoon from the very first impression. 🌿 No Carpet! Clean Wooden Floors The entire room had clean wooden floors instead of carpet, which was great for those sensitive to allergens, making it a good choice for people who avoid carpeted rooms. 👨‍👩‍👦 Spacious Room Perfect for Staying with Kids The room was spacious and equipped with a sink and a large refrigerator, making it convenient for staying with children for a few days. 🌊 Nha Trang Sea View from the Room We could see Nha Trang beach and the sea clearly from the window, giving us a vacation vibe even while staying at a city hotel. 🛗 Private Elevator for Star Suite Room The Star Suite Room has its own dedicated elevator, allowing for a relatively quiet and comfortable ride even during busy times. 🏊 Enough Pool Fun for Kids While not a very large pool, it was sufficient for playing with kids, and with sunbeds and beach chairs available, it was great for relaxing. 🏖️ Private Beach Just Across the Street There is a private beach space in front of the hotel for guests, which was nice as we could go directly from the pool to the sea. 🌴 Renting Beach Chairs for Relaxed Beach Play On the beach, we paid about 100,000 VND to rent two beach chairs, allowing us to enjoy the waves with our child and lose track of time while looking at the sea. 🍳 Breakfast with a Sea View Breakfast time was a bit hectic due to the crowd, but eating while overlooking the sea and beach was enjoyable, and the food was generally decent. 💰 Location + Spacious Room + Value for Money Being able to enjoy the convenient infrastructure of Nha Trang city along with a spacious room, pool, and beach is the biggest advantage of this hotel. ⭐ Especially recommended for such families! With spacious rooms, separate living and bedroom, two bathrooms, wooden floors, pool, and beach access! I recommend this for those who want reasonable prices while enjoying both the conveniences of Nha Trang city and relaxation, rather than flashy luxury resorts. For families like us who want to enjoy dining, shopping, and massage during the day and swimming and beach fun upon returning to the hotel, I think it would be a quite satisfactory choice. 😊🌊
